title: Pure Salamangreat
summary: Salamangreat cards only, with generic staples. Salamangreat Link Monsters can be summoned again using a copy of themselves as the only material ("reincarnation"). A reincarnated Salamangreat gets its strongest effect: Sunlight Wolf recovers a Spell/Trap, Heatleo copies ATK, and Pyro Phoenix destroys every card they control. The 2023 cards lead. Salamangreat of Fire searches a Level 4 or lower Salamangreat. Salamangreat Tiger and Weasel are Tuners that summon themselves, and Salamangreat Burst Gryphon revives a FIRE monster and reincarnates as a Synchro. Salamangreat Raging Phoenix searches any Salamangreat when reincarnated. Gazelle and Spinny keep the GY and field full, and Salamangreat Circle searches. Salamangreat of Fire locks you into FIRE for the turn, so the Extra Deck is all Salamangreat. Bastella, Markhor and Gearblade aren't out in the TCG yet.

Salamangreat Wolvie
Recovers a FIRE monster from the GY.

Link-3: shuffles away a Spell/Trap; reincarnated, sets a monster's ATK.
Newest Link-4: reincarnated, searches any Salamangreat; returns when a FIRE monster falls.
Link-4: reincarnated, destroys every card they control.
Newest Synchro: revives a FIRE monster; reincarnated, revives another next Standby Phase.
Link-1: searches Salamangreat Sanctuary; protects a Salamangreat from the GY.
